intent: Dismissible overlay for short tasks, forms, or extra detail. Composes ModalCard. Not a must-choose confirm.

eyebrow.note: Short area name in the header row, 12px, like Billing · Invoices. Caller-provided.

tone.note: Tone icon (16px, aria-hidden) and status word from KitLabels (info, success, warning, danger) before the eyebrow, so status is never colour alone. neutral shows the eyebrow only.

size.note: sm 352 or md 448 for a short form, lg 576 to review a list. Below 480px (30rem) lg fills the screen.

footer.note: kit Buttons / ButtonGroup, size sm: Cancel, then one primary last.

footerStart.note: Left of the footer actions, first in the footer tab order: an Ask Button (appearance outline, mode neutral, size sm, iconStart MessageCircle) or a count like 6 of 6 selected. Labels are caller-provided.

contained.note: In-canvas docs only. Product screens omit it (portal to document.body).

passthrough.note: Not the portal, root or scrim. Focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return are kit-owned.

requirements: Composes ModalCard with role=dialog and aria-modal
Title (h2) is the accessible name, description is aria-describedby when present
Focus starts on the first field in the body, not Close; with no field the dialog itself takes focus
Focus is trapped while open and the page behind is inert
Escape closes, unless an open panel inside it (Select, DatePicker) handles that Escape first
Scroll lock keeps the scrollbar gutter, so the page does not shift
Focus returns to the opener on close; if the opener is gone, to the page heading (or main)
Unique ids via useId — do not hardcode modal-title
built-in labels (close, closeDialog) come from KitLabelsProvider; English by default

doNot: Do not invent local Dialog, Modal, DialogTrigger, or CommandDialog
Do not use AlertDialog for dismissible work
Do not skip the close control unless showClose is false AND footer/body still provide a way out. Scrim click and Escape still close.
snippet: <Modal open={open} eyebrow="Billing · Invoices" title="Edit invoice INV-2042" description="Change the due date or the amount." onClose={close} footerStart={<Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" size="sm" iconStart="MessageCircle" onClick={ask}>Ask about this</Button>} footer={<ButtonGroup ariaLabel="Modal actions"><Button appearance="outline" mode="neutral" size="sm" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button><Button appearance="solid" mode="primary" size="sm" onClick={save}>Save changes</Button></ButtonGroup>}>...</Modal>
